findings.details: App Router structure present (app/ directory with page.tsx, layout.tsx). However, ALL pages use 'use client' directive, negating RSC benefits. No server components found in routes.
findings.recommendation: Convert data-fetching pages to Server Components. Use 'use client' only for interactive islands. Implement generateMetadata() and generateStaticParams() for SSG/ISR.

findings.details: tsconfig.json has 'strict': true enabled. Proper path aliases configured (@/*).

Tailwind v4.0.0 installed with @tailwindcss/postcss. Custom design system in globals.css using @theme. shadcn/ui NOT properly integrated - no components.json, manual CVA implementation instead of official shadcn CLI setup.
findings.recommendation: Run 'npx shadcn@latest init' to properly configure shadcn/ui. Migrate manual button/card/badge to shadcn registry for consistency and easier updates.

findings.details: @tanstack/react-query NOT found in package.json or codebase. Manual fetch calls with useState/useEffect pattern used throughout.
findings.recommendation: Install @tanstack/react-query v5. Create QueryClientProvider in layout.tsx. Refactor API calls to useQuery/useMutation for caching, deduplication, and background refetching.

findings.details: next-intl NOT installed. Custom i18n context implementation exists at lib/i18n/context.tsx with en/ru locales. Functional but lacks SSR support, route-based locale switching, and next-intl features.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to next-intl for proper RSC-compatible translations, middleware-based locale detection, and SEO-friendly URL structures (/en/, /ru/).

findings.details: next-pwa NOT installed. No manifest.json, sw.js, or service worker registration found. No PWA capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Install next-pwa. Configure next.config.ts with PWA plugin. Create public/manifest.json with app metadata. Enable offline mode for study materials.

findings.details: @xterm/xterm ^6.0.0 and @xterm/addon-fit ^0.11.0 properly installed. LabTerminal component implements WebSocket-based terminal with dynamic import, resize handling, and reconnection logic.
recharts ^2.15.0 installed but NO actual chart components imported or used. Only Phosphor ChartBar icons found. @nivo NOT installed.
findings.recommendation: Implement actual Recharts components (LineChart, BarChart, RadarChart) for analytics dashboard. Consider adding @nivo for advanced visualizations if needed.

findings.details: No error.tsx or loading.tsx files found in app/ directory. No ErrorBoundary components. No Suspense boundaries detected. Missing Next.js App Router error/loading conventions.
findings.recommendation: Create app/error.tsx (global), app/loading.tsx (global), and route-specific error/loading files. Implement React ErrorBoundary class component for client-side error catching. Add Suspense wrappers around async operations.

findings.details: Minimal accessibility implementation. focus-visible rings in button.tsx. Single aria-label in header.tsx. Global focus-visible CSS rule present but uses invalid 'ring' property. No comprehensive ARIA attributes, skip links, or keyboard navigation testing.
findings.recommendation: Fix CSS focus-visible rule (replace 'ring' with 'outline'). Add skip-to-content link. Audit all interactive elements for aria-labels. Implement landmark roles. Test full keyboard navigation flow. Run axe-core automated audit.

critical_gaps: TanStack Query missing - manual state management causes performance issues
No error boundaries - unhandled errors crash entire app
No PWA support - required for offline study functionality
RSC not utilized - all pages are client components
Charts library installed but unused - analytics features incomplete
quick_wins: Add error.tsx and loading.tsx to app/ root (30 min)
Fix invalid CSS focus-visible rule (5 min)
Initialize shadcn/ui properly via CLI (1 hour)
Convert static pages (landing, about) to Server Components (1 hour)

missing_per_plan: zustand (in lockfile but not package.json dependencies)
